# General Contractor in  Northeast Pennsylvania

Professional construction, landscaping, and home improvement services across Wilkes-Barre, Scranton, Pittston, and surrounding NEPA communities. Over 30 years of trusted craftsmanship.

[Get a Free Estimate](tel:+15704791318) [View Our Work](https://nepaclassic.com/#portfolio)

About Us

## Building With  Creativity

NEPA Classic Construction offers over 30 years of experience in general construction — interior and exterior — landscaping, hardscaping, and much more. We take pride in every project, treating your home as if it were our own.

Serving Scranton, Pittston, Wilkes-Barre, and surrounding communities across Northeastern Pennsylvania, we deliver quality craftsmanship at fair prices. Every project begins with a free estimate — no pressure, no surprises.

30+Years Experience

500+Projects Completed

100%Free Estimates

What We Do

## Services Built on  30 Years of Craft

01

### General Construction

Full-service residential and commercial construction, from foundation to finish.

02

### Interior Renovation

Kitchen remodels, bathroom upgrades, basement finishing, and complete interior transformations.

03

### Exterior Work

Siding, roofing, decks, porches, and structural repairs that stand the test of time.

04

### Landscaping

Professional landscape design and installation to elevate your outdoor living space.

05

### Hardscaping

Patios, retaining walls, walkways, and driveways built with precision stonework.

06

### Custom Projects

Unique builds tailored to your vision — if you can dream it, we can build it.
